sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 - Artificial Intelligence Act
sources.legal_effect: Directly applicable in all EU Member States

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 - Digital Omnibus
sources.legal_effect: Amends timelines and provisions of Regulation 2024/1689

sources.title: AI Act Regulatory Framework Overview
sources.legal_effect: Interpretative guidance, not binding

sources.title: AI Literacy Questions & Answers
sources.legal_effect: Clarifies Art. 4 implementation expectations
key_points: No uniform competency level imposed on individuals
Context-dependent measures based on role, experience, use case
Replicating repository practices does not create automatic presumption of conformity

sources.title: Guidelines on the definition of an AI system
sources.legal_effect: Interpretative guidance for Art. 3(1)

sources.title: Guidelines on prohibited AI practices under Article 5
sources.legal_effect: Interpretative guidance for Art. 5 enforcement

sources.title: Guidelines on high-risk AI systems classification
sources.legal_effect: Interpretative guidance for Art. 6 + Annex III

sources.title: General-Purpose AI Code of Practice
sources.legal_effect: Voluntary but may demonstrate adequacy for GPAI obligations

sources.title: Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content
sources.legal_effect: Voluntary but confirmed as adequate for Art. 50 transparency

sources.title: Living Repository of AI Literacy Practices
sources.legal_effect: Examples only; replication does not create automatic conformity

sources.title: AI Act Standardisation Guidance
sources.legal_effect: Explains relationship between harmonised standards and AI Act

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 - General Data Protection Regulation
sources.legal_effect: Directly applicable data protection law
sources.note: AI Act does NOT replace GDPR. Both apply concurrently where personal data is processed.

sources.title: Opinion 28/2024 on processing of personal data in the context of AI models
sources.legal_effect: Interpretative guidance on GDPR in AI context

sources.title: AI Privacy Risks & Mitigations - Large Language Models
sources.legal_effect: Best practice guidance for GDPR compliance in LLM contexts

sources.title: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 - Artificial Intelligence Management System
sources.legal_effect: Not legally binding; may support AI Act compliance evidence
sources.mapping_note: ISO 42001 provides management system framework but does NOT automatically ensure AI Act compliance.

sources.title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 - Information Security Management
sources.legal_effect: Not legally binding; supports cybersecurity requirements

sources.title: ISO/IEC 27701:2019 - Privacy Information Management
sources.legal_effect: Not legally binding; supports GDPR evidence

sources.title: NIST AI RMF 1.0 - Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework
sources.legal_effect: US framework; informative only for EU AI Act

sources.title: OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications
sources.legal_effect: Best practice; not legally binding

sources.title: OWASP Agentic AI Security Guidance
sources.legal_effect: Emerging best practice; not legally binding

sources.title: Intelligenza Artificiale - Garante per la Protezione dei Dati Personali
sources.legal_effect: National enforcement guidance; supplementary to GDPR/AI Act

sources.title: Decreto Legislativo di attuazione del Regolamento UE 2024/1689
sources.legal_effect: Will specify national enforcement authorities and sanctions procedures
sources.note: Italy must designate competent authorities and establish sanction procedures per AI Act Chapter X.

status_legend.BINDING: Directly applicable EU law - Mandatory compliance
status_legend.OFFICIAL_FINAL: Official guidance published - Strongly recommended to follow
status_legend.OFFICIAL_DRAFT: Draft guidance from official body - Monitor for changes
status_legend.COMMUNITY_STANDARD: Industry best practice - Recommended for security
status_legend.ONGOING: Actively updated resource - Regular review needed

monitoring_protocol.action_on_stale: Flag associated controls as REVIEW_REQUIRED until source re-verified
